entries.result: As you cross an alley, two thugs block your path and ask for bribes.

You are tied up and left to die in the sewers. Roll “Defy Danger” (Strength) to try to escape: if you’re successful, mark two Instabilities and increase the Time Limit by two; if you fail, roll “Fight Death”.
You realize you are being followed. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
Walking down a street, you are attacked by a stranger who runs away immediately. Mark one Wound, return this card to the pile and shuffle.
1d6 Clues that you have collected are stolen / destroyed. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
Someone threatens you. Mark one Instability, return this card to the pile and shuffle.
The floor gives way and you fall into what appears to be a crypt. Increase the Time Limit by one as you try to get out.
You are approached by a stranger who “advises” you to stop the Investigation. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
A mob of townsfolk raids your current Location. Roll “Frantic Flee”. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
As you enter / leave a Location, you get shot at point blank. Mark two Wounds.
You see someone you think you know being dragged / pulled into a manhole. Mark one Instability.
You hear a gunshot and then realize the bullet just grazed your ear. Mark one Instability.
You encounter an indescribable being. Roll an Eldritch Creature and prepare to “Confront the Incomprehensible”.
